compareDisposition.rationale: No distinct two-source pairing adds more than this passage and its existing Scripture connections.

observations.body: Walking in statutes is joined to rain, harvest, security, victory, fruitfulness, dwelling presence, and the memory of release from Egypt.
observations.label: Obedience is joined to rain, peace, presence, and freedom

observations.body: Obedience is joined to rain, peace, presence, and freedom belongs to sinai remembered in the Sinai trail.
observations.label: Where this sits

observations.body: Leviticus 26:3–13 supplies later-memory evidence for the event’s developing sequence.
observations.label: Within the Sinai event

observations.body: Later witnesses select and reuse Sinai in their own settings; they remain later readings rather than replacements for the Exodus event.
observations.label: Reading boundary

payload.posture: Read Leviticus 26:3–13 as its own source before carrying it into the wider Sinai trail.
payload.tension: Obedience is joined to rain, peace, presence, and freedom belongs to the sinai remembered movement, but its part in the event must remain distinct from the surrounding speech, response, breach, and renewal.
payload.title: Obedience is joined to rain, peace, presence, and freedom
